Every line that touches this mask, in one call stack

Building the mask takes one line, so a page about only that line would say very little. These frames build it and then keep going — down through the embedding, the projections and the head split — to the single
that finally uses it. That is the only way to see what the mask is protecting: by the time it is used, sequence A’s
looks exactly like a real word.

E · What each of the four numbers in
one card per number, left to right, in the order the shape prints them
A shape, read as four separate questions
Every number in a shape answers one question: how many different values do I need along this direction? A
means "two values, one per sentence". A
does NOT mean "one head" or "one query" — it means "one value is enough for this whole direction, so reuse it everywhere along it". The four
slots always come in this order, because the tensor the mask will be compared with — the attention
— always has its four axes in that same order.
in the cards below always means the same thing: the filler token,
appended to the shorter sentence so both rows could share one rectangular tensor. It is a real row in every tensor of the model and it stands for no word at all.
